name: DDJ-FLX2
notes: Connect by USB MIDI. Use HOT CUE mode (Shift + BEAT SYNC, then pad 1); Shift + pad clears a cue. CFX controls the mixless filter. Browse and load in the workspace. Smart Fader, master CUE, other pad modes, shifted transport and fader start are unmapped. Choose audio outputs manually. Jog calibration and hardware testing pending.

provenance.section: p. 1: deck/jog, mixer and 14-bit controls; p. 2: hot cue pads and vinyl output
pp. 77, 82, 143: Mac audio setup, pad mode selection and USB MIDI for other DJ applications
